name: Physics-IQ

summaryEn: Tests physical prediction through continuations of recorded real-world events.

evidence.locator: Overview; Original / Verified workflows; License and Disclaimer
evidence.statement: The official workflow splits physical-event recordings into conditioning and held-out continuation videos and evaluates generated physical rollouts. The repository maintains original and Verified evaluation variants.
